subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 8: final shas after V41 rev5 (4b7da2... / 330720...), 765 checks
body:
Rev 8 is a rebuild of the same package after V41 rev5 / current IV. No interface change.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 765/765
    249/249 ASan+UBSan, 249/249 -O2, 249/249 TSan; 18/18 real (real vpud OPEN_OK 64x48).
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    vcodecd 391648 B sha256 4b7da254914ad6a15c6c71d5d96e193addcffadc5fcd48d38ed0373722f19168
    n2vcd_cli 70000 B sha256 b62f3cbe6d646207a5064a6b381ff0742ca677acb4177f29ba58b79f302637b0
  bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh -> IOS TOOLS OK
    vcodecd 386048 B sha256 33072030d4dcbf593a98809e46d2ba276d0310e7f4d8a3d86b1f33e5fd517133
    n2vcd_probe 68736, n2vcd_selftest 368272

Both vcodecd: V32/V33 shims present, no fake symbols, --gate, fatal exit 70, slbc=0, no --venc-slow, large-AU out sizing. P04 objects compiled. F14-F21 fixed. Open: only the first phone run (kernel 273 MHz default belongs to K02).
